stages.headline: The general equation of a plane is Ax + By + Cz + D = 0, where n{A; B; C} is a normal vector.
stages.headlineEnglish: The general equation of a plane is Ax + By + Cz + D = 0, where n{A; B; C} is a normal vector.

stages.headline: The plane through M₀(x₀; y₀; z₀) perpendicular to n{A; B; C}: A(x − x₀) + B(y − y₀) + C(z − z₀) = 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: The plane through M₀(x₀; y₀; z₀) perpendicular to n{A; B; C}: A(x − x₀) + B(y − y₀) + C(z − z₀) = 0.

stages.headline: The distance from M₀(x₀; y₀; z₀) to the plane is d = |Ax₀ + By₀ + Cz₀ + D| / √(A² + B² + C²).
